intro: v0.0.20 is a small build about battles fighting the way we decided (#106, #107, #121, #128). Play from a new game as usual; the big things to watch are the Elm & Jenny fights (the lab, Route 22, Pewter) and the Oak & Daisy rematch, with the Research Rules on doubles and then on singles. Tick each change once you've seen it, and use the notes box for anything that feels off.
save: Save: old saves work (you start a new game each round anyway).

items.title: Elm & Jenny and Oak & Daisy: one opponent, one picture (#107)
items.what: Each pair is one trainer with one team of six and one AI, shown as one picture of the two of them (head to thighs, the partner a step behind). The battle text calls them "Elm&Jenny" and "Oak&Daisy". Their Pokémon take turns in the team, so in doubles one of each leads.
items.try: The lab battle, Route 22, the Pewter rematch, and the Oak & Daisy rematch in the lab.

items.title: Their lines mid-battle slide their picture in
items.what: When Elm, Jenny, Oak or Daisy speak mid-battle, their pair picture slides in on their side the FireRed way, and the line starts with who's talking. Their 2-down, 4-down and last-Pokémon lines play in singles too.
items.try: Route 22 or Pewter: watch for the lines after two and four of their Pokémon faint, and when their last one comes out.

items.title: You and Ivy side by side
items.what: Your side of every battle shows you in front and Ivy a step behind, the same way as Elm and Jenny. Debug > Scripts > 14 switches back to the old picture (you and Ivy turned to each other) so you can compare; 14 again switches back.
items.try: Any battle. Then Start > Debug > Scripts > 14 and another battle.

items.title: The Research Rules decide every trainer battle (#128)
items.what: Doubles makes every trainer battle a double; singles goes back to each battle's own style. Curated fights (Elm & Jenny, Oak & Daisy, Delia, Brock's rematch) keep their teams of six either way, so with singles they're 6-vs-6 single battles. Delia no longer forces a double.
items.try: After Daisy's house, play a fight on doubles, then switch Options > Research Rules > trainers to singles and play one again (Delia at home or the Oak & Daisy rematch are quick to reach).

items.title: Oak brings Nidoran♂, not Slowpoke (#121)
items.what: The lab's Slowpoke never battles. Oak's rematch team has Nidoran♂ instead: Nidorino from your first badge, Nidoking from your fourth.
items.try: The Oak & Daisy rematch in the lab, before and after Brock.

items.title: Wild battles after the Oak & Daisy rematch (#106)
items.what: A wild battle right after the rematch could send out Oak's starters instead of the wild Pokémon. It now gets the wild Pokémon.
items.try: Beat or lose to Oak & Daisy, then walk into the grass on Route 1.

items.title: Test mode in single battles
items.what: With test mode on (Debug > Scripts > 9) a single battle used to crash when your next Pokémon went out. Fixed (test builds only).
items.try: Only if you use test mode: a trainer fight on singles.
